title: Naturality of objectwise topological cohomology comparison
statement: Let f:Z -> X be continuous and assume its direct image on abelian sheaves is additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let KX and KZ be the free abelian terminal sheaves, and H_X^p and H_Z^p the canonical Ext cohomology functors [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Let a:KX -> f_*KZ send each sheafification generator h to f^{-1}(h) followed by the terminal-open equality. Suppose additive maps tau_{p,F}:H_X^p(f_*F) -> H_Z^p(F) are given for all p,F and satisfy the resolution-cocycle formula: for all injective resolutions I of F and J of f_*F, all comparisons phi:J -> f_*I over f_*F, and all cycles s,z with a composed with f_*z = s composed with phi^p, tau_{p,F}(J.extMk(s))=I.extMk(z). Then for each coefficient morphism g:F -> G and each p, H_X^p(f_*g) followed by tau_{p,G} equals tau_{p,F} followed by H_Z^p(g). This statement constructs no maps.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemmas 13.18.6 and 13.18.7; with the cohomology definition of Tag 01DZ and terminal-section identity of the proof of Tag 01EZ

proof.text: Use Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk_surjective to represent an arbitrary input class by s in J. Lift the coefficient map g and its pushforward with InjectiveResolution.desc. Apply the already proved terminal-section resolution-cocycle lifting theorem first to s and then to s followed by the lifted pushforward coefficient map, obtaining phi,z and phi-prime,z-prime. The two composites into f_*I-prime agree after the augmentation by their augmentation equations and the coefficient-lift equations.

Direct image sends each term of I-prime to an injective object. Subtract the two composites. Factor its degree-zero component through J.d(0,1) using J.exact-zero.descToInjective. For positive degrees inductively produce t,t-prime with delta(n+1)=t followed by the target differential plus the source differential followed by t-prime: subtract the preceding t-prime followed by the differential, check that the preceding source differential kills this difference using the chain-map identity, and use J.exact-succ.descToInjective. Precomposition by a source cycle makes delta zero in degree zero and a boundary in every positive degree. This is the explicit null-homotopy argument of Derived Categories Tag 013S, with its induction as in Tag 013R; the target complex is not assumed exact.

Reuse sectionEquiv and sectionEquiv_apply from the existing resolution-cocycle lift module (proof-only import all). These sheafification, free-forgetful and Yoneda adjunctions identify terminal-sheaf morphisms with terminal sections. Evaluate on the identity generator. The generator equation ha and naturality show that precomposition z maps to a followed by f_*z corresponds to restriction along the terminal-open equality, an isomorphism. Hence this precomposition is bijective for every coefficient sheaf. Transfer the boundary in the preceding step through this bijection: z followed by the coefficient lift and z-prime differ by a boundary. Mathlib InjectiveResolution.sub_extMk and extMk_eq_zero_iff identify their Ext classes; degree zero instead gives equality of the morphisms by injectivity.

Apply the assumed cocycle formula h-tau to the two matching cycles. Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk_comp_mk-zero computes the coefficient maps in terms of the resolution lifts. The equality of output Ext classes therefore proves the naturality square on the arbitrary input class. ConcreteCategory.hom_ext proves equality of the additive homomorphisms. Degree zero and zero coefficient maps need no extra hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Tags 013P and 013S (comparison and uniqueness), with the explicit null-homotopy induction of Lemma 13.18.4, and Tag 01DZ terminal-section representation; G3 Lean proof uses the existing proved resolution-cocycle lift and proves the null-comparison boundary argument locally. Returned-delivery repair: reuse the lift module private sectionEquiv and sectionEquiv_apply via import all, removing both duplicate declarations.
